hero.title: Grooming that comes to your door.
hero.subtitle: Baths, haircuts, ear and teeth cleaning for dogs and cats, done at your home. No car rides, no crates, no waiting room.

services.name: Bath & brush
services.text: A full bath with a fresh-smelling shampoo, blow-dry and brush-out.

services.name: Haircuts & breed styling
services.text: Neat cuts for every breed, from a quick trim to a full style.

services.name: Ear cleaning
services.text: Gentle ear cleaning as part of every groom.

services.name: Teeth cleaning
services.text: Brushing for fresher breath and healthier teeth.

steps.title: Call or text
steps.text: Tell us about your pet and pick a time that suits you.

steps.title: We come to you
steps.text: Your groomer arrives at your home, ready to work.

steps.title: Fresh and happy
steps.text: Your pet stays relaxed at home and comes back looking great.

items.title: Courteous, reliable groomers
items.text: Clients keep praising our friendly, punctual groomers. Miguel, Carlos, Victor and Pablo are named again and again.

items.title: Fresh cuts, clean finish
items.text: Spotless coats, a pleasant shampoo scent, neat breed haircuts and thorough teeth cleaning.

items.title: Gentle with nervous pets
items.text: Dogs, puppies and cats are handled with patience at home, so nervous pets stay calm.

faq.a: We come to your home and groom your pet there, so there is no travel and no waiting in a salon crate.
Dogs of all sizes, puppies and cats.
We are based in southwest Miami and visit homes across Miami and nearby neighborhoods.
Call or text us at (786) 320-0218. We are available every day of the week.

offer.includes: your own domain and hosting for the first year
